Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The whole manual carries an old content-currency date (stated in part A), so any rule here may have changed since; the freshness debt in part A covers every fact in this section.
The Intermediate Restricted points window conflicts inside the manual: the step list says points within a twelve-month period [A01], while the FAQ and the review table use the hundred-and-eighty days before applying [A06]; only the FAQ and table version is taught (verify TN-GDL-D-WINDOW).
The Unrestricted points limit is worded as more than six points on the step list [A01] but as six or more points in the FAQ [A06]; only the FAQ wording is taught (verify TN-GDL-D-POINTS).
The Intermediate Restricted fee printed in the GDL review table differs from the fee table in the application chapter, so no Intermediate Restricted fee is taught [A07] (verify TN-GDL-D-FEE).
The GDL penalty table extracted column by column; each penalty was matched to its incident row only where the order was unambiguous [A03].
National crash statistics on the teen-risk and work-zone page are attributed figures rather than licensing rules and are not taught as facts.
